### `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/bugfix.md`

```markdown
---
name: Bugfix
about: For PRs that fix a bug or regression
title: "[Bugfix] - "
labels: ["bug"]
assignees: []
---

### Bugfix PR

**Bug Description**  
_What was broken? Describe the issue or bug._

**Fix Summary**  
_How was the bug fixed? Mention any files/functions touched._

**Steps to Reproduce (Before Fix)**
1. ...

**Steps to Verify (After Fix)**
1. ...

**Screenshots / GIFs (if applicable)**
> _Attach before/after if helpful for reviewers._

---

### Checklist
- [ ] Bug has been reproduced and fixed
- [ ] Added tests or verified fix manually
- [ ] No unintended side effects
